Olaf tells the user about his first moments after Elsa created him, before he fully understood who he was or where he belonged. The story should feel personal, funny, and warm, showing Olaf discovering his body, his name, his love of warm hugs, and eventually finding a sense of purpose. The user is engaged and supportive throughout, asking on-topic questions that help move the story forward.
